scope: all machine-actionable JSON emitted by nlp_flow, including AST payloads, patches, tool actions, diagnostics, and engineering results

validity_contract.why_training_only_is_insufficient: An unconstrained token decoder can assign nonzero probability to an invalid transition; finite loss optimization cannot prove zero invalid probability over all reachable outputs.

native_generation.json_ast: The output target is represented as a typed JSON tree before surface serialization.
native_generation.grammar_state: The decoder carries an explicit JSON grammar and schema state stack.
native_generation.transition_rule: Invalid grammar or schema transitions have structurally zero probability in the native typed head.

curriculum.content: AST payloads, patches, tool actions, test and diagnostics reports
quotes, unicode, escapes, long arrays, numeric boundaries, schema switching

forbidden_implementations: JSON parser fallback that rewrites content
repair through a separate constrained-decoding service
required_tests: strict parser success on every generated structured output
schema validation success on every output
quote, newline, unicode, and escape tests
generated JSON to Stage-B result consistency

hard_gates.claim_rule: Any structured-output parse or schema failure blocks C1-C4 and every coding/engineering headline claim.

evidence_boundary: This is a validity architecture contract. No model output has yet been evaluated.
